titre: Suspicious or phishing email
symptomes: phishing email asking for password or payment; strange link or attachment; sender address looks fake
etapes: Do not click any link or open the attachment|Do not reply and never send your password|Use the Report Phishing button in Outlook or forward the email to security@company.example|Delete the email after reporting it|If you already clicked the link or typed your password: change your password now and tell the support
escalade_si: you clicked the link or entered your credentials

titre: Antivirus alert or malware detected
symptomes: antivirus detected malware or virus; quarantine message; files behave strangely; pop-ups
etapes: Do not ignore the alert and do not disable the antivirus|Disconnect the computer from the network (unplug the cable and turn off Wi-Fi)|Let the antivirus quarantine the file and run a full scan|Write down the name of the threat shown in the alert|Do not copy files from this computer to a USB drive or a shared folder
escalade_si: ransomware message or files encrypted or the alert comes back after the scan

titre: Unknown sign-in on your account
symptomes: login from unknown country or device; security alert email; someone logged into my account
etapes: Change your password immediately from a trusted computer|Sign out of all sessions from the account security page|Check that two-factor authentication is enabled|Look at the recent activity list and note anything you did not do
escalade_si: always: the security team must review the sign-in

titre: Unknown USB drive or device
symptomes: found a USB stick; USB drive contains files flagged as malicious; unknown device plugged into my computer
etapes: Do not plug the device in or unplug it now if it is connected|Do not open any file from it|Put the device in an envelope and give it to the security team|Run a full antivirus scan if it was plugged into your computer
escalade_si: always: the security team must examine the device

titre: Unknown program or remote access tool installed
symptomes: unknown remote access tool installed on my laptop; strange program appeared; browser homepage changed; endpoint protection quarantined a suspicious executable
etapes: Disconnect the computer from the network (cable and Wi-Fi)|Do not type any password on this computer|Write down the name of the program and when it appeared|Do not uninstall it yourself: the security team needs to see it
escalade_si: always: the security team must check the computer

titre: Lost or stolen laptop or phone
symptomes: laptop stolen; lost my phone with company email; company device lost on a trip
etapes: Change your company password now from another device|Sign out of all sessions from the account security page|Note where and when the device was lost or stolen|Report the theft to the police if it was stolen and keep the report number
escalade_si: always: the security team must lock or wipe the device

titre: VPN disconnects or does not connect
symptomes: VPN keeps disconnecting; VPN connection fails; cannot connect to VPN from home; remote access drops
etapes: Check that your home internet works by opening a public website|Disconnect the VPN and quit the VPN client completely|Restart the VPN client and connect again|If you use Wi-Fi move closer to the router or use a cable|Restart your computer and try once more
escalade_si: the VPN still drops after a restart and a cable connection

titre: Slow or unstable Wi-Fi
symptomes: Wi-Fi very slow; Wi-Fi drops every few minutes; weak signal in meeting room
etapes: Turn Wi-Fi off and on again on your device|Forget the office network and reconnect with your credentials|Move closer to an access point or use a network cable|Check whether colleagues in the same room have the same problem
escalade_si: several people in the same area have the problem

titre: No network or intranet not reachable
symptomes: no network connection; DNS lookup fails; cannot reach the intranet; remote desktop connection times out
etapes: Check that the network cable is plugged in on both ends|Restart the computer|Open a public website to see if only the intranet is affected|Run ipconfig /flushdns in a command prompt then retry
escalade_si: the whole office or a whole department has no network

titre: Wired Ethernet connection does not work
symptomes: Ethernet connection stopped working after I moved desks; network cable not working; unidentified network on the wired adapter; no internet on the cable
etapes: Check that the cable clicks into the computer and the wall port|Try another wall port or another cable|Look for the link light next to the network port|Disable and enable the network adapter in Settings > Network|Restart the computer
escalade_si: no wall port works at your desk

titre: Mapped network drive disconnected
symptomes: mapped network drive shows a red cross; network path not found; shared drive letter disappeared
etapes: If you work remotely connect the VPN first|Open File Explorer and type the server path (for example \\server\share)|Right-click the drive and choose Disconnect then map it again|Restart the computer to reconnect the drives at sign-in
escalade_si: colleagues cannot reach the same drive either

titre: Slow internet or laggy video calls
symptomes: internet very slow; downloads take forever; video calls freeze and lag; high latency from home
etapes: Run a speed test on a public website|Pause large downloads, uploads and streaming on your network|At home restart your router and wait two minutes|Use a network cable or move closer to the Wi-Fi router|Check whether colleagues have the same problem
escalade_si: the speed stays very low on a cable connection

titre: Printer offline or not printing
symptomes: printer shows offline; nothing prints; print jobs stuck in the queue; scanner jams
etapes: Check that the printer is switched on and shows no error on its screen|Open the print queue and cancel the stuck jobs|Turn the printer off for 30 seconds and back on|Remove and add the printer again from Settings > Printers|For a paper jam open the trays and remove the paper gently
escalade_si: the printer shows a hardware error code or the jam comes back

titre: Laptop battery drains or overheats
symptomes: battery drains in one hour; charger gets hot; fan very loud; laptop overheats or is very slow
etapes: Close the applications you do not use and check the Task Manager for high CPU|Put the laptop on a hard flat surface so the air vents are free|Use the original charger and check the cable for damage|Restart the laptop and install pending updates
escalade_si: the battery swells or the charger or laptop is too hot to touch

titre: Monitor or keyboard does not work
symptomes: second monitor stays black; docking station; keys no longer respond; mouse not detected
etapes: Unplug and plug again the cable of the monitor or keyboard|Try another port or another cable if you have one|Restart the computer while it is connected to the docking station|Press Windows+P and choose Extend for a second monitor
escalade_si: the device does not work on another computer either

titre: Webcam, microphone or headset not detected
symptomes: webcam not detected during video calls; camera not found by Teams; headset microphone not detected; no sound in the headset
etapes: Check the privacy shutter or the camera key, and the mute button of the headset|In the meeting app open Settings > Devices and choose the right camera and microphone|Unplug the device and plug it into another USB port|In Windows Settings > Privacy allow apps to use the camera and the microphone|Restart the computer
escalade_si: the device does not work on another computer either

titre: Scanner gives blank pages or does not scan
symptomes: scanner produces blank pages; scanned document is empty and white; scan to email never arrives; scanner does not start
etapes: Check which side of the document faces the glass or the feeder|Clean the scanner glass with a dry cloth|Choose the right source (glass or document feeder) in the scan settings|Turn the scanner off for 30 seconds and back on|Scan one test page
escalade_si: the test page is still blank

titre: Laptop does not turn on or does not charge
symptomes: laptop does not turn on; no power light; battery does not charge; docking station does not charge my laptop
etapes: Plug the original charger directly into the laptop, without the docking station|Check that the charger light is on and try another wall socket|Hold the power button for 30 seconds, then press it once|Leave the laptop charging for 15 minutes before trying again
escalade_si: there is still no light with the original charger

titre: Account locked after too many attempts
symptomes: account locked; too many password attempts; cannot log in
etapes: Wait 15 minutes: the lock is released automatically|Check that Caps Lock is off and the keyboard layout is correct|Sign in again with your current password|If you forgot your password use the self-service reset page
escalade_si: the account is still locked after 15 minutes

titre: Password expired or reset link not working
symptomes: password expired; reset link does not work; cannot change password
etapes: Open the self-service reset page from a private browser window|Request a new reset link: only the latest link is valid|Choose a password that follows the policy (12 characters at least)|Update the saved password on your phone and other devices
escalade_si: the reset page shows an error twice

titre: Permission denied on a folder or application
symptomes: permission denied on shared drive; no access to CRM or HR portal; new employee has no access; two-factor codes rejected
etapes: Check that you use your own account and not a shared one|Sign out and sign in again so your group membership is refreshed|Ask your manager to confirm which access you need|For two-factor codes check that the time on your phone is set automatically
escalade_si: you need a new access right: the request must be approved by an administrator

titre: Two-factor authentication after a new phone
symptomes: authenticator app stopped working after I changed phones; MFA codes rejected on the new phone; lost phone with the authenticator
etapes: Check that the date and time of the phone are set automatically|Sign in with a backup method (text message or backup code) if you set one|From your computer open the security info page and add the authenticator on the new phone|Remove the old phone from the list of methods
escalade_si: you have no backup method: the identity team must reset two-factor authentication

titre: Mailbox or shared mailbox not accessible
symptomes: cannot open the shared mailbox of my team; mailbox access lost after a department transfer; delegate access to a mailbox missing
etapes: Restart Outlook: a new shared mailbox can take up to one hour to appear|Open the mailbox in webmail to see if the access works there|Add the mailbox manually in File > Account settings > More settings > Advanced|Ask the mailbox owner to confirm that you were added
escalade_si: the access was never granted: the owner must request it

titre: Sign-in to an application fails
symptomes: I can log in to Windows but not to the application; single sign-on error; unauthorized error when opening the intranet; sign-in page keeps looping
etapes: Sign out of the application and sign in again|Open the application in a private browser window|Clear the cookies of this site in your browser|Check that the date and time of your computer are correct|Try another browser
escalade_si: the error stays in a private window: your account may need the access right

titre: Charged twice or wrong invoice amount
symptomes: charged twice; invoice shows the wrong amount; bill includes a service never ordered
etapes: Download the invoice and the bank statement that shows the payments|Check the invoice number and the period of each charge|Write down the amounts that are wrong|Attach these documents when you answer the ticket
escalade_si: always: refunds and corrections are made by the billing team

titre: Card payment declined
symptomes: payment declined; card payment refused; subscription renewal failed
etapes: Check the card expiry date and the billing address|Ask your bank whether the payment was blocked|Try the payment again once only to avoid double charges|Use another approved payment method if you have one
escalade_si: the payment is declined again with a valid card

titre: Refund or missing receipt
symptomes: need a refund for a cancelled licence; payment receipt never sent
etapes: Check your spam folder for the receipt|Download the receipt from the billing portal under Payments|For a refund note the licence name and the cancellation date
escalade_si: always for a refund: only the billing team can issue it

titre: Charged for inactive users or too many licences
symptomes: charged for inactive employee licenses; too many licences on the invoice; licence count does not match our users
etapes: Export the list of assigned licences from the admin portal|Remove the licences of people who left|Note the invoice number and the licences that should not be billed|Attach the list when you answer the billing team
escalade_si: always: credits are issued by the billing team

titre: Wrong tax or billing address on the invoice
symptomes: invoice uses the wrong tax region; VAT number missing on the invoice; billing address is incorrect; tax amount on the invoice is wrong
etapes: Open the billing profile in the portal and check the address and the VAT number|Correct the profile: the next invoice uses the new details|Note the number of the invoice that is wrong|Ask for a corrected invoice if a past invoice must be changed
escalade_si: a past invoice must be corrected

titre: Payment shown as overdue although paid
symptomes: billing portal shows a payment as overdue even though it was paid; payment reminder received after paying; credit note issued but balance unchanged
etapes: Check the payment date: a bank transfer can take 3 to 5 business days|Find the bank reference of the payment|Upload the proof of payment in the billing portal|You can ignore the reminder for 5 business days
escalade_si: the payment is still overdue after 5 business days

titre: Application crashes after an update
symptomes: application crashes on startup; crash after update; installer fails with an error
etapes: Restart the computer to finish the update|Open the application again and note any error message|Run the repair option from Settings > Apps|Uninstall and reinstall the application from the Company Portal
escalade_si: the application still crashes after reinstalling

titre: Outlook does not receive emails
symptomes: Outlook stopped receiving emails; emails stuck in outbox; mailbox not updating
etapes: Check the status bar: Outlook must say Connected|Click Send/Receive all folders|Restart Outlook in safe mode (outlook.exe /safe) and then normally|Check that your mailbox is not full and empty Deleted Items
escalade_si: colleagues do not receive your emails either or webmail shows the same problem

titre: Excel or Office freezes or shows an error
symptomes: Excel freezes; file with macros; error code on export; browser extension stopped working
etapes: Save your work and close the program|Open the file again with macros disabled|Install pending Office updates|Repair Office from Settings > Apps > Microsoft 365 > Modify
escalade_si: the file is damaged or the error code comes back after the repair

titre: Installation or update fails
symptomes: installer fails with error 1603; software update rolled back without completing; installation stops halfway; license activation wizard fails
etapes: Restart the computer and close all other applications|Install the software from the Company Portal rather than a downloaded file|Free at least 5 GB of disk space|Run the installation again and note the error code
escalade_si: the same error code comes back twice

titre: Meeting audio or screen sharing problems
symptomes: others cannot hear me in a meeting; no sound in Teams calls; cannot share my screen in a call; meeting app shows a black screen when sharing
etapes: Leave the meeting and join again|Check the speaker and the microphone chosen in the meeting settings|Close other apps that use the microphone or the camera|Update the meeting app and restart it
escalade_si: the problem happens in every meeting after the update

titre: A file does not open or the app closes when saving
symptomes: PDF editor closes when saving a file; file does not open; file opens in the wrong application; document says it is corrupted
etapes: Save a copy of the file on your computer and open the copy|Open the file with another application|Set the default app in Settings > Apps > Default apps|Restore a previous version from OneDrive or SharePoint (Version history)|Repair the application from Settings > Apps
escalade_si: the file stays damaged: a technician can restore it from a backup

titre: A company service is down
symptomes: server down; website returns 500 error; service unavailable for everyone; portal down after maintenance
etapes: Check the status page of the company services|Ask a colleague whether the service works for them|Do not restart servers or devices yourself|Note the time when the problem started and the error message
escalade_si: always: an outage is handled by the operations team

titre: Email or file server unavailable
symptomes: email service unavailable for the whole office; file server unreachable for all departments
etapes: Check the status page and the announcements channel|Save your work locally until the service is back|Do not send the same email many times
escalade_si: always when several people are affected

titre: Business application out of service
symptomes: payment platform out of service; database server down; whole team blocked
etapes: Check the status page of the application|Note the exact error message and the time|Tell your manager if the outage blocks a deadline
escalade_si: always: the incident must be escalated at once

titre: Nobody can sign in
symptomes: identity service unavailable company-wide; single sign-on down for everyone; nobody can log in to any application
etapes: Check the status page of the company services|Do not reset your password: it will not help during an outage|Keep working offline on files saved on your computer|Note the time and the error message
escalade_si: always: an outage is handled by the operations team

titre: Collaboration platform down
symptomes: enterprise collaboration platform down across the organization; SharePoint unavailable for everyone; chat and meetings down for all users
etapes: Check the status page and the announcements channel|Use phone or email to reach colleagues meanwhile|Save your documents locally until the service is back|Note the time when the problem started
escalade_si: always: the operations team must restore the service

titre: Central business service unavailable for everyone
symptomes: all branches report the central ERP service is unavailable; main business application down for every department; the company website is unavailable to customers
etapes: Check the status page of the application|Ask a colleague in another office whether it works for them|Note the exact error message and the time|Tell your manager if the outage blocks a deadline
escalade_si: always: the incident must be escalated at once
